verdict.line: You lose if you let Aatrox stack Q resets and land Infernal Chains uncontested before level 6; you win every trade after that by out-scaling him with W poke and shutting down his all-ins with your ult.

brief.thesis: Aatrox needs to land W (Infernal Chains) or connect a Q (The Darkin Blade) edge to get his all-in going, while Mordekaiser can poke him down safely with W (Siphon of Destruction) without ever entering auto-attack range. Once you hit 6, R (Realm of Death) turns every Aatrox all-in or R (World Ender) engage into a coinflip you control, since you can remove him from the fight entirely before he gets value.

theirWindow.when: E (Umbral Dash) up and W chains land
theirWindow.what: He can fear-dash onto you, chain Q resets, and pop passive Deathbringer Stance for a big empowered auto. Respect this and don't stand in melee range while his E is available, especially levels 3-5 before your W poke chip is significant.

yourWindow.when: his E (Umbral Dash) just missed or is on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Walk up and land W into E (Death's Grasp) to pull him in, then Q (Obliterate) for the full combo. Without his dash he has no way to escape your E pull or punish you for engaging.

start.why: The passive block and regen negate his poke-heavy Q1 and passive auto chip damage in the level 1-3 window.

boots.why: Reduces the physical chip from his auto-heavy trading pattern and empowered Deathbringer Stance hits.

core.why: True damage ramp and omnivamp let you win extended trades and outlast his all-ins.
Burn damage punishes him for standing in your W cone and scales your ult duels.
Magic pen plus armor and a taunt aura give you the bulk to survive his skirmish burst while amplifying your own.

situational.when: he builds lifesteal or grievous wound counters are already down and he keeps sustaining through your poke
his Deathbringer Stance and Q healing are keeping him in fights longer than expected
the enemy team stacks magic damage around him and you need raw magic resist over burn

runes.keystoneWhy: Rewards the slow, poke-and-walk-up trading pattern this matchup wants and gives permanent max health for the 1v1 ult duels.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you reset off his poke and stay relevant to sidelane pressure once he starts splitpushing after 14; Flash covers your lack of a dash if he lands a chain into an all-in.

playing.title: Poke with W, don't auto trade
playing.detail: Land Siphon of Destruction from max range whenever he pushes in. Trading autos gives him free Deathbringer Stance procs, which you don't need to take.

playing.title: Punish missed E
playing.detail: The moment Umbral Dash whiffs or is on cooldown, walk up and land E into Q for a full combo. He has no answer to your pull without his dash up.

playing.title: Save R for his all-in or his ult
playing.detail: Ulting him the instant he pops World Ender (R) or commits Q-E-W into you removes him from the fight before he gets value, since Realm of Death takes him out of both teamfights and healing range.

playing.title: Track his Q charge count
playing.detail: If he's already thrown two Darkin Blade charges into minions or missed you, his damage for the next several seconds is far lower. That's your cue to step up and trade.

playing.title: Don't fight into his passive stack
playing.detail: Deathbringer Stance refreshes on ability cast, so if he just used any spell, assume the next auto is empowered and back off half a second before committing.

playing.title: Shove and roam off Teleport
playing.detail: Once you hit your Liandry's power spike around 9-13, you outscale his lane presence. Shove the wave and use Teleport to contest objectives rather than staying to farm a lane you're already winning.

playing.title: Respect all-ins pre-6
playing.detail: Before your ult is up, a full Q-W-E-passive combo from him at level 3-5 can genuinely threaten your health bar. Play for trades, not all-ins, until level 6.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the standard Mordekaiser bruiser build as of my last training data (Riftmaker/Liandry's core, Grasp of the Undying keystone); verify exact item costs, stats, and rune tree layout in-client since these get reworked periodically.
